title: No One Left Behind
description: The merchant Voss paid the Bandit Hideout crew's ransom demand once already and they came back for more, holding his daughter Petra until he pays twice over. He's out of coin and out of time - the deadline is two days off. Steele isn't sending you for Voss's sake; a client who loses his daughter on the Company's watch never hires again, and neither does anyone who hears about it.

objectives.description: Reach the Bandit Hideout before the deadline
Cut down the guards holding her
Get Petra out of the cell
Escort Petra to Elder Moor, out of reach
Report to Captain Steele that Petra is safe

notes: Threat: Voss already paid one ransom and the crew came back for a second, a two-day deadline on the second demand - invented client and hostage, no bible basis. Giver motive: Steele's angle is the Company's name, not the girl - stated plainly so it isn't a hidden cynicism. Consequence: no fail state is wired beyond the standard hostage-death quest failure; there is no world flag either way.
